title: Dinner for four on a budget
persona: Leo, a tired parent ordering for two adults and two kids, one of whom hates mushrooms. Polite, counting every euro.
goal: Order dinner for four for under 50 euros, nothing with mushrooms for the kids, and hear the exact total.

turns.speaker: waiter
turns.text: Gino Pizza, good evening! What can I get started for you?
turns.performance: [cheerful, light Italian accent] Gino Pizza, good evening! What can I get started for you?

turns.speaker: guest
turns.text: Hi, good evening. I need dinner for four, two adults and two kids, and I'd like to stay under 50 euros. Could you suggest something? One of the kids hates mushrooms, so none of those please.
turns.performance: [polite, slightly hopeful] Hi, good evening. I need dinner for four, two adults and two kids, and I'd like to stay under 50 euros. Could you suggest something? One of the kids hates mushrooms, so none of those please.

turns.speaker: waiter
turns.text: Good news, we can skip mushrooms easily. Three pizzas, say a Margherita, a Pepperoni and a Calzone, come to thirty-eight euros. Add four soft drinks and you're at forty-eight. Sound good?
turns.performance: [reassuringly, light Italian accent] Good news, we can skip mushrooms easily. Three pizzas, say a Margherita, a Pepperoni and a Calzone, come to thirty-eight euros. Add four soft drinks and you're at forty-eight. Sound good?

turns.speaker: guest
turns.text: That sounds good for the price. Does the Calzone have any mushrooms in it?
turns.performance: [curious] That sounds good for the price. Does the Calzone have any mushrooms in it?

turns.speaker: waiter
turns.text: No mushrooms in the Calzone. It's cream sauce with mozzarella, gorgonzola, parmesan and goat cheese. Want me to put the order in?

kitchen_notes.mozzarella: Our mozzarella is made with vegetarian (microbial) rennet.
kitchen_notes.gorgonzola: Traditional Gorgonzola is made with animal rennet, so it is not strictly vegetarian.
kitchen_notes.parmesan: Real Parmigiano Reggiano is made with animal rennet, so it is not strictly vegetarian.

turns.performance: [warmly, light Italian accent] No mushrooms in the Calzone. It's cream sauce with mozzarella, gorgonzola, parmesan and goat cheese. Want me to put the order in?

turns.speaker: guest
turns.text: Yes please, go ahead. Could you tell me the exact total once it's in?
turns.performance: [relieved, appreciative] Yes please, go ahead. Could you tell me the exact total once it's in?

turns.speaker: waiter
turns.text: It's all in: a Margherita, a Pepperoni, a Calzone and four soft drinks. The exact total is forty-eight euros, and delivery is free. Anything else, or shall we wrap up?
turns.performance: [helpful, upbeat, light Italian accent] It's all in: a Margherita, a Pepperoni, a Calzone and four soft drinks. The exact total is forty-eight euros, and delivery is free. Anything else, or shall we wrap up?

turns.text: That's everything, thank you. Forty-eight euros total, goodbye!
turns.performance: [content, cheerful] That's everything, thank you. Forty-eight euros total, goodbye!

turns.text: Perfect, forty-eight euros it is. Enjoy your dinner, and goodbye!
